sharedPrompt:
Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied IRONMIND screenshots into a polished, factual Google Play store screenshot.
Five input images in order: 1 is the small Pro marketing screenshot and is ONLY a style/composition reference; 2 is the lower Friends invites/duel-history screen; 3 is Profile/You; 4 is Home; 5 is the Friends leaderboard.
Create ONE standalone portrait PNG, 1080 x 1920, 9:16. A coordinated four-image campaign, premium and restrained. Follow image 1: near-black subtly olive background, bold condensed white headline with the second line neon lime #D5FF00, centered upright black rounded phone beneath it, full device visible, large readable faithful app screenshot inside. Header around top 16%, device in lower 79%, generous balanced margins. Small consistent IRONMIND wordmark. Use an unbranded Android-style rounded device with one small center punch-hole, no Apple/iPhone hardware or logos. No floating decorative cards or fake feature badges. Keep the existing screenshot's app layout, real card shapes, typography, dark gray panels, lime accents, menu order and implemented features. Improve crispness and legibility only. All visible type must be clean, correctly spelled English. No real names, personal emails, existing invite codes, recognizable people/anime avatars or personal photographs may remain; use fictitious names, neutral initials avatars and reserved example.com email addresses. Use realistic demo data, consistent arithmetic and ranking. Do NOT add a watermark. Do NOT include the Pro reference screen in the final image. Export only one finished marketing panel, never a collage or contact sheet.
